method: Same linked executables as targeted gate, without the optional case filter. Full16-case sequence per process;5 warmups and20 samples per case; two rounds with binary order reversed. Exactness remains outside timing.
timingStatus: Provisional shared-host measurements; separate method, not pooled with targeted pairs.
